regime_context: Leadership is split: Oil & Gas Producers rank #1 on raw momentum but are NOT trend-eligible, while Big Banks are the dominant eligible trend (durability 0.8, breadth 1.0). Rotation breadth is narrowing at 0.44 and the narrative is not one-narrative dominant; gate_helps is true so trend discipline has historically cut drawdown on the TSX but track-record dir_accuracy (0.313) is poor, so conviction should stay low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Oil & Gas Producers (rank #1, score 1.215) regains trend-eligibility via its durability_bar improving above the gate threshold — currently 0.19, well below the trend line — and if Big Banks' breadth (currently 1.0) holds near full while the rotation breadth narrows further; a sustained rise in Oil & Gas durability above ~0.4 with breadth expanding beyond 0.5 would signal a leadership handoff from banks back to energy.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the only high-durability, broad, eligible trend in the rotation (durability_bar 0.8, breadth 1.0, eligible true). The absolute-trend gate is the one validated drawdown-control leg on this market, and banks carry the cash/leadership weight (0.25) of the headline narrative. Lean overweight as a stay-with-the-confirmed-trend stance, not a momentum chase.
evidence: gate_helps: true on this market history
theses.dissent: Big Banks rank only #2 on raw momentum behind Oil & Gas, and the poor dir_accuracy (0.313) in the track record suggests even eligible trends frequently fail to confirm directionally in Canada.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO underperforms XEG.TO by more than 5% over the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities & Renewables combine trend health (durability 0.8) with high breadth (0.917) and the only negative crowding_z (-0.24) among eligible trends, meaning it is not attention-crowded. With gate_helps true, a broad but uncrowded trend is a reasonable low-conviction overweight.
theses.dissent: Utilities rank only #5 on momentum score and often lag in rotation when banks lead; a defensive theme can underperform if the broader market risk-on extends.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO lags ZEB.TO by more than 8% over the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: Consumer Staples & Retail is eligible, durable (0.79), and has full breadth (1.0), but it is crowded (crowding_z 1.03). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, NOT a fade or sell, so a mild overweight with capped size is the disciplined read.
theses.dissent: Crowding flag could indicate attention has already peaked; reflexivity means continued strong performance is possible but entry risk is higher than uncrowded names.

falsifier.text: XST.TO lags the S&P/TSX benchmark by more than 4% over the next 20 trading days.
